_note: Prompts for AI illustrations of CONCEPT civics questions only (see docs/image-plan.md). Written by hand for Language Lab. tools/images/generate-illustrations.mjs joins style + scene + rules into the prompt it sends and records that full prompt in data/images/illustrations-manifest.json. An illustration is shown only after the owner sets reviewed: true in that manifest.

estimate.basis: Read on 2026-11-26 from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing: gpt-image-2.6-flare costs $30 per 1M image output tokens and $5 per 1M text input tokens. The docs give no fixed per-image price for GPT-Image-2.6 (only an interactive calculator); the per-image table for gpt-image-2, at the same $30 output rate, lists $0.053 for medium quality at 1024x1024. Estimate: $0.053 output + about $0.002 for the prompt text = about $0.055 per image. Token use can differ by model, so the real cost may differ.

style: Flat, simple editorial illustration with clean shapes and soft, even light. Warm and calm mood. Limited palette: deep navy #0d2052, red #b22234, white, and a light navy tint; small touches of warm off-white. Plenty of empty space, centred composition, no gradients or textures.
rules: Rules: no text, letters, numbers or writing of any kind, including on signs, papers, screens or books; no real or historical person and no likeness of anyone; no recreation of a historical event or of a historical document; no seals, eagles, badges, emblems or government logos; no flag except, at most, one plain U.S. flag in the background; any people are generic, diverse adults of mixed ages, shown from behind or as simple shapes without detailed faces.
